seed: A screen recording whose system audio came in quiet (peak -32.7 dBFS, -42.7 LUFS, the level the user's own recordings measured on 2026-09-25), at Next defaults with no flag set. The waveform draws in decibels so the quiet sound is visible at all; right-click the audio segment, Normalize > Peaks to -1 dB, and the segment wears +31.7 dB, the Gain row says so, and the waveform grows. Undo takes it back; the panel's Normalize button does the same; Normalize > Loudness for Web sets a smaller gain because the peak ceiling holds it.

steps.note: The quiet recording picked: its system audio drawn in decibels on the Audio track, small but visible; the Sound section's Gain row at 0.0 dB with Normalize beside it
Right-click, Normalize > Peaks to -1 dB: the segment wears +31.7 dB, the waveform fills its lane, the Gain row reads +31.7
Undo put the gain back to nothing; the panel's Normalize button set the same +31.7 dB
Normalize > Loudness for Web: +28.7 dB (the fixture measures -42.7 LUFS in ffmpeg), less than the peak normalize, so the loudest peak stays under -1 dB
